title: Slim Bookmark
description: A narrow row project for practicing edges, tension, and a tiny tassel finish.
expectationText: A neat little project that rewards careful tension and gives you a finished gift in under an hour.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.instruction: Chain 8 stitches for a slim bookmark width.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Single crochet in the second chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 24
steps.instruction: Chain 1, turn, and single crochet across each row.

steps.title: Add a tassel
steps.instruction: Cut a few yarn strands and attach them to one short edge.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Trim the tassel evenly and weave in the starting tail.
